titleFormatted.en: [[monitor]] !{{usually does not start in this hour|usually starts in this hour}} (under [[percent]] % of its cycles)

hint.en: True when fewer than this percent of the monitor's cycles started in the current hour of the day (your time zone), so a start now is out of the ordinary. Use it after Activity started: a fryer on at 3 am. False until the monitor has at least 20 cycles to learn from. Works with Activity and State monitors.
